title: Sherpa voice ASR UI validation: Cohere Transcribe (en)
description: Drives the /features/asr screen end-to-end with the Cohere Transcribe model and the bundled `en.wav` test sample, asserting the transcript displayed in the UI is non-empty (i.e. not '(no speech detected)'). Requires the Cohere model to be downloaded on the target device.
